items.name: Start Here
items.summary: Four hours that tell you what the exam is, how it is scored, how to plan for it, and how to review — before you drill anything.
items.goal: Finish with an accurate model of the test and a study plan built from your own diagnostic rather than from a template.

items.name: Logic Foundations
items.summary: Conditional, quantifier and causal reasoning, plus the flaw catalog — the machinery every Logical Reasoning family runs on.
items.goal: Be able to translate any conditional, combine quantifiers correctly, recognise the causal template on sight, and name a flaw in plain language.

items.name: Logical Reasoning End to End
items.summary: The full Logical Reasoning path: foundations, then every question family in the order they are best learned.
items.goal: Classify any LR stem in five seconds and know the method that family rewards before reading the stimulus.

items.name: Reading Comprehension End to End
items.summary: Section shape, the four-line passage map, every question family, and the comparative set.
items.goal: Read a passage once for structure and answer its questions from the text rather than from memory.

items.name: Timing and Review
items.summary: The procedural half of the score: pacing, triage, elimination discipline, blind review, and the error log.
items.goal: Convert questions you already know how to do into questions you actually get right under the clock.

items.name: The Writing Sample
items.summary: What Argumentative Writing is for, and a five-paragraph method that fits inside 35 minutes.
items.goal: Draft a position you can defend, engage the strongest objection, and self-score against the rubric.

items.name: Logic Games as a Trainer
items.summary: Analytical Reasoning left the scored exam in 2024; this path uses it for what it is still the best practice at — constraint tracking.
items.goal: Build the conditional discipline and exhaustive case analysis that conditional Logical Reasoning rewards.

items.name: The Final Two Weeks
items.summary: No new method. Pacing, triage, the error log, and test-day conduct.
items.goal: Arrive having rehearsed the conditions, with a triage policy you have already used under time.
